title: Parts filters support multiple choices and can be cleared
refs: Filters (no Jira epic) (spec v1.6 §2 Feature Overview -> Parts Filters; §4 Key Decisions -> "Context-specific filter sets on Parts and Reports" + "Multi-select where it makes sense"); Branko answers 2026-07-31 Q2/Q3/Q5/Q7; Figma 11884-16885
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Parts area of the app with some sample data present.
custom_steps:
1. Open a Parts filter button that shows a list of choices.
2. Select more than one choice, then look at the filter button.
3. Use the Clear selection action, then look at the filter bar for a way to clear all filters.
custom_expected:
1. More than one value can be chosen inside the filter, and the button shows what you picked.
2. Clear selection removes the choices for that one filter.
3. A Clear filters button appears in the filter bar while any filter is set, and using it clears them all at once - exactly as it works on the Work Orders page.
